q: Turbo codes and LDPC codes are practical capacity-approaching codes. LDPC codes (Gallager, 1962) are characterised by:
opts: A sparse parity-check matrix H with density O(1/n) — most entries are 0
A parity-check matrix with all entries 1
exp: LDPC (Low-Density Parity-Check) codes have sparse H: each row and column has O(1) ones. This allows efficient belief-propagation (sum-product) decoding on the Tanner graph. LDPC codes asymptotically achieve Shannon capacity on the BEC and approach it on other channels.
